hero.slogan: "In the name of blocks, open to the world."
hero.description: iGCraftLit is a community for Minecraft creators. Gathered by blocks, we bring together players who love building and exploring to shape an open, free gaming ecosystem.

why.label: WHY
why.p1: iGCraftLit — in the name of blocks. Blocks stand for creation, curiosity and perseverance — exactly how we approach games and life.
why.p2: We believe a community should be open, free, and player-owned. Not for profit, not for fame, but for the purest passion for creation.

focus.label: FOCUS
focus.lead: The fields we love and keep cultivating.

i1.title: Survival Exploration
i1.desc: Guides forged in vanilla and modded survival, recording every adventure and discovery.

i2.title: Building & Design
i2.desc: Share builds and inspiration, from cozy huts to grand engineering projects.

i3.title: Redstone Engineering
i3.desc: Study redstone circuits and contraptions that set your ideas in motion.

i4.title: Mods & Resources
i4.desc: Explore mods, modpacks and resource packs that push the blocky world's boundaries.

what.label: WHAT
what.lead: What we do to keep the community thriving.

i1.title: Community Discussion
i1.desc: High-quality posts and conversations covering every corner of the game and beyond.

i2.title: Resource Sharing
i2.desc: Guides, modpacks and assets curated into a searchable community knowledge base.

i3.title: Events & Meetups
i3.desc: Online co-op and build events that turn solo play into shared joy.

i4.title: Q&A Support
i4.desc: Beginners ask, veterans answer — together we crack every hard problem.

values.label: VALUES
values.lead: In the name of blocks, we live by these spirits.

i1.title: Creation
i1.desc: Blocks combine freely, and so do we: everyone can build a world of their own.

i2.title: Curiosity
i2.desc: Stay curious about the unknown — new seeds, mods and playstyles await.

i3.title: Passion
i3.desc: "Lit" means ignited: we light up every gathering with genuine enthusiasm.

cta.label: CTA
cta.title: Join Us
cta.description: One block, one passion, built together. In the name of blocks, open to the world.
